entities.summary: Major General (Tit.) Dr. Adnan Kapau Gani or commonly abbreviated as A.K. Gani was an Indonesian doctor, politician, actor and military figure. He served as Deputy Prime Minister in the Cabinet of Amir Sjarifuddin I and the Cabinet of Amir Sjarifuddin II.
